name: CITIC Telecom International Holdings Limited
summary: CITIC Telecom International Holdings Limited is a global telecommunications provider offering carrier services such as mobile roaming, virtual network enablement, IP packet exchange, SMS firewalls and voice hubbing, plus data platforms and IoT services. For businesses it supplies network connectivity, data center, cloud, security and communication platform services. In Macau it supports digital infrastructure and provides local 4G, roaming and OTT TV to consumers.
